Hi! I’m Dr. Gigi, I’m a pediatric physical therapist and oral motor specialist dedicated to: 

👶 Helping children with tongue and lip ties thrive
🤱 Educating parents and medical professionals on tongue ties and why physical therapy can be so helpful
🍼 Offering clinical excellence to patients by incorporating scientifically backed treatments with an emphasis on a whole-body approach. 

I’m blessed with an incredible team of experienced pediatric therapists who love working with babies and are their biggest cheerleaders. 

Together, we’ve created a beautiful community where parents feel seen, heard and safe. 

Most importantly, we’ve helped thousands of babies thrive without tear-jerking therapy providing fun, low-stress and brain-building therapy for infants.

📅 Schedule a consultation: https://www.milkmatterspt.com/
